title: StarCraft Devs Promise New Game Will Definitely Release in 2030
take: Well, this is certainly a spicy one for the StarCraft faithful! Blizzard just dropped a bombshell, announcing a new StarCraft game—but wait, it’s an open-world shooter, not an RTS, and it's not landing until 2030. That's a brave, some might say audacious, move to transform such a beloved sci-fi strategy series into a shooter and then give us a release date that’s practically a decade away. Developers say this firm 2030 target keeps them "honest," acting as a rallying cry, which sounds like they're really aiming for something massive and authentic that both veterans and newcomers will love. Here's hoping it's worth the wait when we finally get to go boots-on-the-ground against a terrifying 10-foot Hydralisk!

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World Has 500 Beasts to Collect, and They're All Super Weird | IGN Preview
take: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World is shaping up to be a gloriously bizarre monster-collecting adventure! With a whopping 500 unique monsters designed by the legendary Akira Toriyama, fans of the long-running series will have their hands full, especially since you can even roll with an all-Slime party if you want. Plus, returning protagonists Bianca and Nera from Dragon Quest V aren't just along for the ride; their unique perks and preferred monster types add a cool strategic layer to building your ultimate team. Get ready to dive into some charming, high-fantasy weirdness!

title: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei Brings Serious Martial-Arts Spectacle to Soulslikes | IGN Preview
take: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei is set to bring some seriously slick martial-arts action to the Soulslike genre! This upcoming action-RPG blends intense wuxia-inspired combat, reminiscent of Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, with parkour-style action-platforming that'll make Assassin's Creed fans feel right at home. You’ll be playing as a Ming Dynasty imperial agent, taking down threats with graceful wall-runs and air-streaking attacks, all while building internal energy for critical strikes. It sounds like a visually exciting, less fantastical take on the Chinese-mythology action-RPG, and we can't wait to see if it delivers on that promise of stylish, skillful combat!

title: Grand Theft Auto VI Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers Are Up for Preorder
take: Get ready to cruise through Vice City in style because limited-edition Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 DualSense controllers are up for grabs! Sony and Rockstar are dropping two sleek designs, one black and one white, both sporting a subtle "VI" on the touchpad and cool palm tree etchings. That black version is a PlayStation Direct exclusive, so if you want to capture that Vice City nightlife vibe, you better jump on it fast because these beauties, with their color-shifting grips and all the usual DualSense perks, are sure to sell out quicker than you can say "wasted."

title: Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 Remakes Are Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Very Soon
take: Horror hounds, get ready to scream on the go! Capcom is bringing the fantastic Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 remakes to the Nintendo Switch 2 next month, dropping digitally on October 16th. This means you can finally experience these modern classics – complete with all their DLC, including Ada Wong's Separate Ways – wherever your spooky heart desires. While no wild new features are announced, having nearly the entire numbered Resident Evil saga natively playable on the Switch 2 is a massive win for fans and portable gaming alike. Plus, the upcoming Resident Evil Veronica remake is also slated for the console, keeping the fear train rolling!

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Release Date Confirmed, and It Looks Like a Faithful-Looking Return With a Few Surprises
take: Get ready to revisit Hyrule, because The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is getting a full remake for the Switch 2, hitting shelves November 5! Nintendo is bravely dropping this N64 classic in the same month as GTA 6, proving they truly believe in Link’s legendary adventure. Expect a stunning new 3D look, modern upgrades like manual jumping and motion controls, and even fully voiced cutscenes (though Link's still the strong, silent type). Plus, you can hum Ocarina songs instead of just mashing buttons and grab a real Ocarina accessory! This faithful remake, with its Threads of Time quest log and new minigame areas, is shaping up to be a truly epic return.

title: The Secretlab Labor Day Sale Has Big Discounts on Its Titan Gaming Chairs Including the Nanogen Edition
take: Gamers, if you're still rocking that rickety kitchen chair during your epic play sessions, Secretlab's Labor Day Sale is calling your name! Their highly-rated Titan Evo gaming chairs, beloved by pros and casual players alike, are seeing some sweet discounts. Not only can you grab the standard versions, but fantastic licensed designs for games like Genshin Impact and anime like Jujutsu Kaisen are also included. Even the super-luxe Nanogen Edition, rarely on sale, is getting a price cut – perfect for leveling up your comfort and crushing those high scores!

title: Exodus Ending and Character Fates Change Based on Your Choices
take: Archetype Entertainment’s upcoming RPG, Exodus, is shaping up to be a true player-choice powerhouse, confirming that your decisions will dramatically alter character fates and even the game's ending! Narrative director Drew Karpyshyn, a Mass Effect legend, revealed that companions might not stick with you if your choices rub them the wrong way, potentially leading to their departure or even impacting their survival. Forget simple morality systems; this sounds like deep, evolving relationships and branching storylines where every choice truly matters, even in optional content. Get ready for some serious re-playability when Exodus drops on April 7, 2027, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC!

title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Could Be Great, But There's Some Things We Can't Ignore...
take: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is blowing us away with its absolutely gorgeous visuals, making those old pointy polygons a distant memory! The new Damocles Room, famed for its raining swords, looks incredible and preserves that classic "tiny human in a giant tomb" feeling, amplified by next-gen graphics. However, while director Raul Siqueira talks about knowing what to change, the new "helpful" swords and a surprising lack of self-awareness might leave some fans scratching their heads. This "unified timeline" game is trying to bridge a lot of Lara's different eras, and we're curious to see how that tonal blend plays out when we finally get our hands on it!

title: White House Launches Arcade.Gov, a Minigame Site Where You Catch Immigrants, Build a Tetris Border Wall, and 'Fill Your Kids' Trump Accounts' With Bitcoin
take: The White House just dropped Arcade.Gov, a new mini-game site that's certainly… something! Featuring titles like "Rio Run" (a Snake-like game where you round up "crossers") and "Build the Wall: Zombie Border Siege" (a Tetris clone with green aliens), these games offer a uniquely political spin on classic gameplay. It’s wild to see familiar game mechanics twisted into something so provocative, especially with parody console startup animations. And with Nintendo already calling out the regime for IP infringement, this site is definitely stirring up a storm!

title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Is Getting a Pair of Limited Edition PS5 Controllers
take: Well, hello there, gorgeous! Grand Theft Auto 6 is gearing up for its big November 19 launch, and PlayStation is definitely making sure you know where to play it best. They just dropped news of two slick, limited-edition GTA 6 PS5 controllers, boasting the iconic VI logo, palm tree etchings, and a snazzy neon purple trim. While these beauties will set you back $84.99 and likely sell out faster than a Vice City street race, they’re a cool way to show your love for the game and get those DualSense features ready. Rockstar and PlayStation are really hyping up the PS5 experience, promising exclusive features and full use of the controller's tech.

title: The Humble Choice September 2026 Lineup Is Live With Frostpunk 2, Sonic X Shadow Generations, and 6 More Games
take: September’s Humble Choice lineup just dropped, and gamers, you won't want to miss this! For a sweet $14.99, you can snag eight awesome PC games for your Steam library, including the highly-anticipated Frostpunk 2 and the lightning-fast Sonic X Shadow Generations. IGN gave Frostpunk 2 an 8/10 for its complex new scale, and Sonic X Shadow Generations earned a stellar 9/10, praised for doubling its campaign length with creative levels and a graphical upgrade. This isn't just a steal; it's a super-boost for your game collection!

title: Afterworld: The First Hands-On Preview: A (Probably Too Early) Taste of Paradox’s Next Big Thing
take: Paradox fans, get ready for *Afterworld*, their first new grand strategy series since 2019! This post-apocalyptic North American wasteland sim lets you rebuild society how you want, from terraforming to… well, cannibalism. While early previews suggest it's rough around the edges and still needs plenty of polish, the core idea of blending RTS and grand strategy with deep customization sounds absolutely wild. We're talking *Fallout* meets *Crusader Kings III* levels of intricate world-building and moral choices, where your survivors can be nostalgic rebuilders or nomadic cannibals. Fingers crossed Paradox takes their time because this could be an apocalyptic epic!

title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons Gameplay Reveal Gives Extended Look at Combat, Exploration, and Traversal
take: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons just dropped a killer gameplay reveal at Gamescom, and it's shaping up to be an awesome single-player, open-world action-adventure! Get ready to wield forbidden magic as Kaatri, a warlock with a special Warlock's Eye that lets her see Raw Magic, helping her find and improve spells. The game's all about creative problem-solving and environmental use, letting you pull down columns with Tasha's Leash or swap positions with Fey Switch. Plus, classic Eldritch Blast is in, and you can even conjure a sword for melee combat – talk about versatile!

title: PSA: Nintendo Switch 2 Gets a $50 Price Increase on Tuesday
take: Uh oh, Switch fans! That sweet, sweet Nintendo Switch 2 is about to get a little less sweet, price-wise. Starting Tuesday, September 1st, Nintendo is bumping the console’s price up by a cool $50, bringing it to a total of $500. It seems even the House of Mario can’t escape rising component costs forever, and to add insult to injury, all those neat game bundles have mysteriously vanished too. If you’ve been eyeing a Switch 2, now's your absolute last chance to snag one at the current $450 price before it jumps up!

title: IGN's Top-Reviewed Nintendo Switch 2 Games
take: The Switch 2 has been out for a year, and IGN is already dropping some serious must-play recommendations! Forget endless searching, they've rounded up all the Nintendo-exclusive games that scored an 8 or above, and frankly, we're stoked. Topping the list is a surprising 10/10 for "Donkey Kong Bananza," hailed as a groundbreaking 3D platformer that might just be the best decision Nintendo could've made, even over a Mario title. Plus, enhanced editions of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom and Breath of the Wild are making us want to dive back in, confirming the Switch 2 is truly delivering on the exclusive front. Time to get gaming!

title: The Ultralight Gaming Mouse Arms Race Has Entered a New Phase
take: The ultralight gaming mouse scene is wild right now, and it seems like everyone has a different idea of what makes the ultimate pointer! Corsair's Sabre V2 Pro is all about shedding grams, hitting an incredible 36g by ditching some features and even a bit of build quality, but still delivering fantastic performance for those lightning-fast FPS flicks. Meanwhile, Razer's Viper V4 Pro is refining the basics with a new 50,000 DPI sensor and faster optical switches, while Logitech's G Pro X2 Superstrike is borrowing haptic feedback and rapid trigger from keyboards. It's fascinating to see these heavy hitters taking such diverse paths – what's your pick for the best way to lighten up your game?

title: Star Citizen Spinoff Squadron 42 Delayed to 2027, Dev Insists It's Because of GTA 6
take: Well, here we go again! Star Citizen's single-player epic, Squadron 42, has been pushed back to Q2 2027. Cloud Imperium Games CEO Chris Roberts insists it's all because Grand Theft Auto 6 is going to hog all the attention this fall, meaning his "spiritual successor to Wing Commander" wouldn't get its due. While it’s certainly true that GTA 6 is a massive deal, it’s hard to ignore that Squadron 42 has been in development for over a decade with a star-studded cast and a budget that rivals Rockstar's behemoth, yet still struggles to lock down a launch date. This latest delay, following a messy Star Citizen dev stream, adds another chapter to the ongoing saga of a game that keeps us waiting.

title: Rockstar Games Finally Addresses Extraordinary and 'Heartbreaking' GTA 6 Leaks, Warns Players That 'Some Spoilers' May Now Impact 'The Intended Game Experience'
take: It’s been a rough week for Rockstar, who finally addressed the “heartbreaking” GTA 6 leaks! With over a dozen gameplay clips (and counting!) flooding the internet, the studio acknowledged that some of its intended surprises for players might now be spoiled. While they’re obviously not thrilled about their super-secret game being broadcast this way, Rockstar is still hyping us up for a November 19 launch and promising an "Extended Look" reveal soon. It seems these leaks are still a mystery, but one thing's for sure: gamers are buzzing, and this just makes us even more curious to see the finished product!

title: GTA 6 Leaker Releases Nightclub Gameplay Video, Defends Crypto Scheme
take: The GTA 6 leaks just keep coming, with a new video showing Jason cycling on a beach packed with NPCs – which is great for fans, but terrible for Rockstar. This "CyberLeek" character is still pushing their bizarre crypto scheme, claiming they're fighting for gamers and taking "huge risks" by spoiling the game. With the official Netflix reveal just around the corner, we hope Rockstar can still deliver that incredible first look despite the constant drip-feed of stolen content. Honestly, we're just ready for the real deal!

title: Exclusive: PokémonXP and 2026 Pokémon World Championships Pokémon Center Merch Reveal
take: Get ready to snag some serious Pokémon loot because the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in San Francisco are dropping exclusive merch that’s out of this world! Not only is it the 30th Anniversary, but also the first official PokémonXP fan-convention, meaning triple the awesome with three distinct product lines. We're talking a brand-new accessorized Pikachu plush from the legendary Steiff (their previous ones went for $400!), glow-in-the-dark Umbreon and Elgyem items, and even lava flow glitter pins. Head to the Pokémon Center pop-up, grab a store reservation, and get ready to enter the lottery for those must-have items!

title: GTA 6 Leaker Releases More Gameplay Videos Despite Rockstar Owner Take-Two's Microsoft and Discord Subpoenas
take: The GTA 6 saga just got wilder! Despite Take-Two’s legal moves against Microsoft and Discord to unmask the leaker, “CyberLeek” dropped *two more* gameplay videos this week. We’re talking supercar action, an armed robbery, and even a strip club scene that seems to be directly taunting Take-Two. These new leaks bring the total to eight this week alone, all pushing a memecoin as part of what looks like a big crypto stunt. With significant story spoilers now a real threat, and Rockstar still scratching their heads over how this is happening, you gotta wonder if anything can stop this leaker!

title: The Sinking City 2 Review
take: Get ready for some Lovecraftian horror, folks, because The Sinking City 2 is diving deep into the weird! This survival horror sequel from Frogwares is being hailed as "Resident Evil in a fedora," and that's a huge compliment for fans of modern RE games. With its gorgeous, detailed 1920s Arkham setting, an intriguing cosmic horror plot, and a charmingly pulpy protagonist, Calvin Rafferty, it sounds like a truly atmospheric and engaging experience. Plus, with unkillable stalkers and fishy monstrosities, it promises to keep you on the edge of your seat!

title: Woot Is Practically Giving Away Sonic Games to New Customers Today
take: New players, get ready to zoom! Woot is practically gifting Sonic games today, and if you’ve never shopped with the Amazon-owned retailer, you’re in for a treat. For a measly dollar, you can snag Sonic x Shadow Generations on Switch or Xbox, or grab Sonic Racing Crossworlds for only eight bucks on Switch. Just punch in the promo code HELLOTEN at checkout for a sweet $10 off your first order. This is a fantastic chance to jump into some critically acclaimed Sonic action without breaking the bank!

title: Arc Raiders Gets Unlikely Subway Crossover — Buy a Meal for Exclusive Outfits
take: Who knew a Footlong could get you battle-ready? Embark Studios' intense extraction shooter, Arc Raiders, is getting a super unexpected crossover with Subway, letting you deck out your Raider in sandwich-inspired gear. Just buy a qualifying meal and snag a code for exclusive Subterranean outfits and weekly rotating in-game goodies, all leading up to the massive Frozen Trail update on October 8th. It's definitely a wild way to fuel up for the new map, challenges, and deeper progression coming to the game.

title: Tides of Annihilation is a Stylish King Arthur-Inspired Slash ‘Em Up that Balances Spectacle with Substance | IGN Preview
take: Tides of Annihilation is shaping up to be a stunning Arthurian slash 'em up! This King Arthur-inspired action-RPG, from first-time developer Eclipse Glow Games, had some initial style-over-substance worries, but a recent preview confirms it’s just as exhilarating to play as it is dazzling to watch. Imagine hopping off at Waterloo and ending up in an Elden Ring-esque, blighted London—that's the vibe! While Gwendolyn's movement needs a tiny tweak, the combat, featuring spectral Round Table knights and flashy ultimate skills, sounds incredibly satisfying. Get ready to hack and slash through a ruined British Museum when this one hits!

title: Drakong’s New Attack on Titan-Themed Collectible Controllers Come In a Blind Box
take: Alright, Attack on Titan fans, get ready to add some serious cuteness to your gaming setup! Hyperkin’s sub-brand Drakong just dropped the PixelByte controllers, tiny, pixelated NES-style controllers featuring chibi versions of your favorite AoT characters like Eren and Levi. And here's the kicker: they're coming in blind boxes! While we probably won't be using these keychain-sized beauties to beat Elden Ring, they're fully functional with PC, Switch, iOS, and Android, offering 12 hours of playtime. With seven different variants (plus a super rare chase controller!), getting your hands on a specific character might be a gamble, but the thrill of the unboxing and adding a new collectible to your shrine is totally worth it. Pre-order yours for $24.99 and start collecting!

title: Star Wars: Magellan Was a AAA Action RPG Where You Could Play as a Jedi or Mandalorian
take: Woah, another Star Wars game bites the dust! Footage just dropped for *Star Wars: Magellan*, a totally scrapped action RPG that would’ve let us finally choose between playing as a Jedi *or* a Mandalorian. Imagine the possibilities! Developed by the now-closed Echtra Games, this "shoot and loot" title had big plans, including a companion bond system and epic Force powers versus jetpack flamethrowers. It’s a real bummer to see such an ambitious project, codenamed Magellan, join the graveyard of canceled Star Wars dreams like *1313*. What a missed opportunity for PC, Xbox, and PS5 players!

title: 'I Want to Set the Record Straight: That Is Not Happening' — Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch | D23 2026
take: Good news, Kingdom Hearts fans! Co-director Tai Yasue and series creator Tetsuya Nomura just dropped some serious truth bombs at D23 2026, squashing all those "will it, won't it" delay rumors for Kingdom Hearts 4. They're 100% committed to a late 2027 launch, promising smooth development and no last-minute pushbacks. That means we can all stop worrying about a wait longer than the 13 years between KH2 and 3, and breathe a sigh of relief about getting a physical release before Sony's 2028 cutoff. Get ready for more Disney magic and hopefully, some familiar Final Fantasy faces on PC, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S!

title: I Hope GTA 6 Borrows a Lot From GTA 4
take: Grand Theft Auto 4 is still a blast, even 18 years later! One gamer recently revisited Liberty City and found Niko Bellic’s grimy, lived-in world and notoriously tricky driving controls oddly charming. While GTA 5 offered more polished handling, the loose, dangerous feel of GTA 4’s vehicles added unexpected thrills to every chase. Plus, the surprisingly deep relationship system was a cool way to experience moving to a new city, rewarding players for building bonds and unlocking perks like weapons and even helicopters. Here's hoping GTA 6 takes notes from this classic’s unique charm and finds a sweet spot between old-school grit and modern polish!
